title: ALMA-IMF: XXI. N<SUB>2</SUB>H<SUP>+</SUP> kinematics in the G012.80 protocluster: Evidence of filament rotation and evolution
question: Characterize dense gas kinematic processes, line-mass profiles, and evolutionary stages of the two main filaments (R1 and R2) in the G012.80 massive protocluster using N2H+(1-0) and complementary lines.

what.value: First core catalog of the full ALMA-IMF sample (57 dense cores in G012 with masses 0.6-6.2 M_sun and temperatures 25-100 K)

evidence.quote: (cite: fabien2024) constructed the first core catalog of the full ALMA-IMF sample based on the 1.3 mm and 3 mm continuum emission.
In G012, they detected 57 dense cores with estimated masses of 0.6-6.2 M$_{\odot}$ and temperatures of 25-100 K.

what.value: DCN(3-2) molecular line data and spectral parameters (including line-of-sight velocities) for 38 cores in G012

evidence.quote: As follow-up, (cite: DCN) used the DCN molecular line emission to study the core population from (cite: fabien2024). For G012, they were able to estimate spectral parameters of 38 cores, including their line-of-sight velocities.

what.value: Catalog of 94 prestellar and protostellar cores in G012

evidence.quote: Deeper, (cite: armante2024) constructed a catalog of G012 cores complementing dust continuum emission (at both 1.3 mm and 3 mm) with molecular emission from $^{12}$CO (2-1), SiO (5-4), CH$_3$OCHO, and CH$_3$CN spectral lines. They classified the cores as prestellar or protostellar, finding a total of 94 detections.

what.value: Core mass, temperature, and luminosity estimates in G012 (masses 0.3-9.5 M_sun)

evidence.quote: Additionally, (cite: motte2024) provided new mass, temperature, and luminosity estimates for cores in the remaining ALMA-IMF protoclusters using radiative transfer modeling. For G012, they found protostellar and prestellar cores distributed over mass ranges of 0.3-9.5 M$_{\odot}$.

what.value: H2 column density and dust temperature maps of G012

evidence.quote: Here, N(N$_2$H$^+$) is the N$_2$H$^+$ column density map described above, and N(H$_2$) is the H$_2$ column density map from (cite: pierre2024).

evidence.loc: DCN accretion evidence in the R2 filament and towards the central OB star cluster
evidence.quote: Recently, (cite: pierre2024) derived a dust temperature map of the G012 protocluster, finding values of $\sim$ 35 K at the top of R2.

what.value: H41alpha recombination line data, SiO(5-4) data, C18O(2-1) data, and 1.3 mm and 3 mm continuum data from ALMA-IMF

evidence.quote: These include the H41$\alpha$ recombination line (cite: roberto2024), which traces H ii regions associated with ionizing sources in the protocluster center; DCN ($J$=2$-$1; (cite: DCN)), which traces more compact and warmer emission compared to N$_2$H^+$; SiO ($J$=5$-$4; (cite: towner2024)), used to analyze potential outflow features; and C$^{18}$O ($J$=2$-$1; (cite: atanu2024)), which traces compact emission in the central region of the protocluster as well as more extended and fainter emission in the surroundings.

Moreover, the 3 mm continuum exhibits high-flux intensity distributions appearing as bubbles in the protocluster center (cite: continuum), similar to the H41$\alpha$ distribution (bottom-left panel of Fig. [12](#fig:TRACERS)).

what.value: Line-mass profile parameters for comparison regions (L1482-S, ONC, Orion ISF, G351.77)

evidence.loc: Line-mass profiles and associated 3D model quantities
evidence.quote: Relative to other star forming regions (see Fig. [6](#fig:enclosedmass)), the filaments in G012 exhibit significantly higher line-mass profiles, up to three times more dense than extended regions such as the G351.77 protocluster (cite: reyes2024).

evidence.loc: DCN accretion evidence in the R2 filament and towards the central OB star cluster
evidence.quote: From previous catalogs (cite: tom2012; tom2016; furlan2016; kainulainen2017; stutz2018; gonzalez2019) we derive a SFR of 95 M$_{\odot}$ Myr$^{-1}$ and a SFE of 0.008 for protostellar cores in OMC-2.

recipe.goal: Data preparation, continuum subtraction, feathering, and S/N masking
recipe.method: Clean N2H+(1-0) observations with the ALMA-IMF pipeline, subtract continuum using imcontsub in emission-free channels, combine 7m, 12m, and TP data using feather, and construct pixel-by-pixel S/N maps from emission-free RMS noise.
key_parameters: fitorder = 0 in channels 12 to 20 km s^-1 for imcontsub
S/N threshold = 12 for N2H+(1-0); 5 for DCN(3-2), C18O(2-1), SiO(5-4); 7 for H41alpha

recipe.goal: Spectral line fitting of N2H+(1-0) hyperfine structure and complementary lines, and velocity component separation
recipe.method: Fit N2H+(1-0) hyperfine structure with 1 and 2 velocity components using PySpecKit specfit (n2hp_vtau), clean bad fits based on uncertainty thresholds, merge 1- and 2-component models into First (FVC) and Second (SVC) Velocity Components separated at 35.6 km s^-1, and fit single-Gaussian models to DCN, H41alpha, and SiO.
key_parameters: 1-component guesses: Tex=31.3 K, tau=3.8, Vc=37 km s^-1, sigma=0.78 km s^-1; 2-component guesses: Tex=(15, 20) K, tau=(1, 3), Vc=(33, 37) km s^-1, sigma=(1.4, 0.47) km s^-1; limits: Tex (2.8, 150) K, tau (0.001, 10), Vc (25, 45) km s^-1, sigma (0.23, 5) km s^-1
Cleaning cuts: Vc and sigma errors < 0.3 km s^-1, sigma error != 0, tau/e(tau) > 1, tau <= 100; FVC/SVC velocity boundary = 35.6 km s^-1
assumptions: Up to two velocity components adequately characterize the N2H+ spectra

recipe.goal: Moment maps and position-velocity (PV) diagram construction
recipe.method: Construct moment 0, 1, and 2 maps for FVC and SVC, identify main filaments R1 and R2, rotate N2H+ data cubes by 45 deg with respect to the protocluster center to vertically align filaments, and generate intensity-weighted PV diagrams parallel and perpendicular to the region.
key_parameters: Spatial rotation angle = 45 deg; R1 and R2 box dimensions = 0.56 pc length x 0.22 pc width

FilFinder parameters: smooth size = 5 pix (0.05 pc), size thresh = 550 pix^2 (0.05 pc^2), adapt thresh = 50 pix (0.49 pc), fill hole size = 20 pix^2 (0.002 pc^2), skel thresh = 80 pix (0.78 pc), branch thresh = 20 pix (0.20 pc)

recipe.goal: N2H+ column density, relative abundance X(N2H+), and total H2 mass estimation
recipe.method: Calculate N(N2H+) from fitted Tex, tau, and sigma for FVC and SVC after removing biased pixels, reproject N(N2H+) to the 0.83'' pixel scale of the Dell'Ova et al. (2024) N(H2) map, compute pixel-to-pixel ratio X(N2H+) = N(N2H+)/N(H2), find the mode of X(N2H+) via Freedman-Diaconis histogram binning, and convert N(N2H+) to total H2 mass.
key_parameters: Constants: g = 3, A = 3.6e-5 s^-1, Eu = 4.47 K; pixel exclusion cuts: Tex = 150 K and tau < 0.2 (30% of pixels discarded), tau/e(tau) > 2; N(H2) S/N > 3; reprojected pixel scale = 0.83''; Freedman-Diaconis bin width = 0.377 x 10^-10 (40 bins)
assumptions: Representative constant relative abundance X(N2H+) = (0.93 +/- 0.10) x 10^-10 across the region

recipe.goal: Filament alignment, ridgeline-averaged velocity gradients, line-mass profiles, and rotation toy model
recipe.method: Trace peak intensity/column density along the filament y-axis to define ridgelines, smooth ridgelines with a 1D uniform filter, straighten filaments to projected radius, measure the transverse velocity gradient in R1 via weighted linear fit, fit power-law line-mass profiles lambda(omega), derive 3D cylindrical density, potential, and acceleration profiles, and compute the centrifugal-to-gravitational force ratio Fc/Fg in R1.
key_parameters: 1D uniform filter window size = 1 pixel for ridgeline smoothing
assumptions: Cylindrical 3D geometry and inclination angle theta = 0 deg (cos(theta) = 1, filament in plane of the sky)

recipe.goal: Star formation rate (SFR), star formation efficiency (SFE), and core velocity estimation
recipe.method: Calculate SFR = M_cores / t_cores and SFE for prestellar and protostellar cores in R1 and R2 using core masses and classifications from Armante et al. (2024) and Motte et al. (2025), and derive new core line-of-sight velocities by fitting single-Gaussian models to average DCN and N2H+ spectra extracted within core ellipses.
key_parameters: Prestellar core lifetime t_cores = 1.2 Myr; protostellar core lifetime t_cores = 0.5 Myr (also tested 0.3 Myr); cloud mass uncertainty = 11%
Mean velocity offset V_DCN - V_N2H+ ~ 0.16 km s^-1 used to correct N2H+-only core velocities
assumptions: Prestellar lifetime = 1.2 Myr and protostellar lifetime = 0.5 Myr

score_reason: The post-imaging analysis recipe is exceptionally well documented in the text and appendices (explicit CASA version, tasks, line-free channels, PySpecKit version, guesses, limits, S/N thresholds, error cuts, FilFinder parameters, and analytic equations), and the ALMA-IMF reduction repository is linked. However, exact box coordinates, tclean imaging parameters, and custom post-processing scripts are not directly provided.
rediscovery_reason: The ALMA-IMF Large Program data (2017.1.01355.L) are public in the ALMA archive, the spectral fitting and kinematic analysis steps are thoroughly parameterized with open-source Python tools (PySpecKit, FilFinder, scipy), and the main results (velocity gradients, line-mass power laws, SFR/SFE, core velocities) are quantitative.
